quests.title: The Powder Keg
quests.desc: The Blackridge Gaol is a battleground of wills. Decide the fate of the prison by siding with the lawful but ruthless Warden, the corrupt but pragmatic Deputy, or the desperate and volatile inmates.

stages.text: Witness the tension. Talk to Garr, Veit, and Knuck Sela to understand the three-way power struggle.
Gain leverage. Acquire a piece of significant evidence (Veit's smuggling routes, a hint about the Black Cells, or proof of inmate unrest).
Commit to a faction. Your choice will lock you into one of three distinct final acts.

choices.text: Path of Order: Work with Warden Garr.
Path of Corruption: Work with Deputy Veit.
Path of Chaos: Work with Knuck Sela and the inmates.

stages.text: (Order) Expose Deputy Veit's corruption and help the Warden perform a full security sweep, crushing inmate resistance.
(Corruption) Frame Warden Garr using falsified evidence or expose her Black Cells operation, allowing Deputy Veit to seize control.
(Chaos) Sabotage key security points, arm the inmates, and incite a full-blown prison riot.
